summary: BPTT on a vanilla Elman RNN (hidden=128, tanh) achieves **perfect performance** (100% per-symbol accuracy, 100% sequence-level accuracy) on the 5-symbol copy task within just **200 training steps**, with the 90% accuracy threshold crossed as early as step 100 (~0.82s on an A100 GPU). This establishes a strong reference baseline: biologically-plausible learning rules (RFLO, e-prop, STC-Credit) should aim for >95% per-symbol accuracy within 3000 steps to be considered "within reasonable range of BPTT" on this task.
